source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 334 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 334 was established by Ordinance No. 20694, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 25, 1990. Ordinance No. 20694 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 20694 was amended by Ordinance No. 24890, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 10, 2002. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20694; 24890; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 334 is established on property generally bounded by Pearl Street, McKinney Avenue, Olive Street, and Cedar Springs Road. The size of PD 334 is approximately 4.8625 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20694; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, all regulations, uses, and other requirements contained in Ordinance No. 18580, the Oak Lawn Special Purpose District, which was approved by the Dallas City Council on February 6, 1985, and which established Planned Development District No. 193, as amended, (“PD 193”), apply in this district. [Note: The regulations of PD 193 are codified in Part I of Article 193 of this chapter.]

(b) PEDESTRIAN SKYBRIDGE means a structure constructed above grade primarily to allow pedestrians to cross a city right-of-way. A pedestrian skybridge use does not include use of a structure constructed primarily for automobiles. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850; 26425)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 334A). (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850; 26425)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For Phase One, as shown on the conceptual plan, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 334B). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For Phase Two, as shown on the conceptual plan, a detailed development plan, as defined in Chapter 51A, must be approved by the city plan commission before the issuance of any building permit on Phase Two of the Property. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850; 26425)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.106. USES.

The only uses allowed in this district are those uses permitted in a heavy commercial subdistrict in PD 193, and a pedestrian skybridge (by SUP only). (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850; 26425)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.107. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Maximum floor area for the development on the Property is 847,240 square feet, or a floor area ratio of 4.0:1. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.108. MAXIMUM HEIGHT.

(a) Except as provided in this section, no structure may exceed 285 feet in height.

(b) In Phase One, a maximum of two lightning prevention system masts may project up to 15 feet above the maximum structure height.

(c) In Phase Two, structures located on a roof, such as chimneys, clerestories, communication towers, cooling towers, elevator penthouses or bulkheads, mechanical equipment rooms, vent stacks, and visual screens that surround mechanical equipment, may project up to 25 feet above the maximum structure height.

(d) In Phase Two, a maximum of two lightning prevention system masts may project up to 40 feet above the maximum structure height. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850; 26425)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.109. LOT COVERAGE.

Lot coverage on the Property may not exceed 50 percent. A minimum of 30 dwelling units must be provided on the Property if lot coverage exceeds 35 percent. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.110. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided as required in PD 193. All required off-street parking must be located below grade. Seventy-five percent of the required parking for hotel uses may be packed parking as defined in PD 193. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850)

sections.title: Parking Garage/Off-Street Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.111. PARKING GARAGE/OFF-STREET LOADING.

All ingress to and egress from below-grade parking and loading facilities must be approved by the director of public works and transportation and shown on the detailed development plan required in Section 51P-334.104. Loading spaces must be provided as required in PD 193, except that no more than two 12-foot by 55-foot spaces and two 12-foot by 25-foot spaces are required. No more than one of the two 12-foot by 25-foot loading spaces is required for an office use. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Unless otherwise stated in this section, landscaping must be provided as required in PD 193.

(b) For the purpose of this article, the length of “tree planting zone one” is the length of the Property adjacent to the projected street curb, excluding driveways, and the width of zone one is four feet, measured from the back of the projected street curb.

(c) The number of trees required in tree planting zone one is determined by the length of tree planting zone one, and required trees must be planted in tree planting zone one based on the tree spacing provisions of PD 193.

(d) Eighty percent of tree planting zone one must have a permeable surface and must be landscaped in compliance with the regulations and ordinances of the city.

(e) For the purpose of this article, the length of “tree planting zone two” is 60 percent of the length of the Property adjacent to the projected street curb, excluding driveways, and the width of zone two is 50 feet, measured from the boundary line of the Property.

(f) The number of trees required in tree planting zone two is determined by the length of tree planting zone two, and required trees must be planted within tree planting zone two based on the tree spacing provisions of PD 193. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.113. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-334.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 334 is located on Zoning Map No. J-7. (Ord. Nos. 24890; 25850)
